dialogues.speaker: Sobolev
dialogues.text: Hmm. Looks like those three fools managed to make it onto the transport. Thank goodness... So long as they didn't hold anything up, giving them grief over it's more trouble than it's worth.

dialogues.speaker: Sobolev
dialogues.text: Thanks for making the trip. At least one thing finally got sorted out today... Oh, right. Here's your payment. Thanks for the help.
